models.composition: Democritus Meditating on the Seat of the Soul — Mont-de-Marsan Marble
models.qualification: Photographic capture by pattarrian of the marble in Parc Jean-Rameau. Largest provider thumbnail reviewed: adult bald and bearded philosopher, bare torso, skull, arms, feet and complete seat/base visible. Public GLB listing reports no image textures; verify preservation of source color, possibly carried by vertex colors. Native preflight must inspect crown, bent elbow, hand around skull, back and underside.

Photogrammetric capture by noe-3d.at. Largest provider thumbnail reviewed and compared with the publisher’s photograph of the exact installed group: mature muscular helmeted man and rearing horse retain strong detail, marble discoloration and projecting limbs. Thumbnail framing crops the lowest feet/base edge, so this does not establish full lower coverage. Publisher reports nearby-tree obstruction. Native front, above, reverse and underside inspection must confirm both crowns, raised hooves, arms, feet/base and tree-side coverage before approval; do not reconstruct missing areas.

Photographic capture by Tyler Jackson (tyjajack). Largest provider thumbnail inspected: detailed mature male torso, exposed hollow opening at the upper arm and the sculpture base are retained with photographic surface color. The publisher describes the physical sculpture as hollow aluminum and calls the mesh watertight; this is not independent native quality approval. Native front, above, reverse and underside review must confirm intentional open rims and interior wall surfaces, with no invented closures or other material loss.
